spec_match.rationale: Clearly labelled 'Synth-backed simulator', it contrasts punctuated vs unpunctuated dictation output and reads both through real speechSynthesis so the prosody difference is demonstrable.

interactive.rationale: Four read-aloud buttons drive speechSynthesis over the paired panels for both scenarios.

edge_cases.rationale: Two scenarios with paired outputs, but no handling shown for speechSynthesis being voiceless (as in headless) beyond silence.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: clicked read-left; no console errors, but audible synthesis cannot be verified headlessly and the page gives no visual speaking-state feedback to confirm the utterance ran.

accessibility.rationale: For an accessibility-impact page there is no visual speaking indicator, no utterance progress state, and the read buttons are icon-prefixed with duplicate names across scenarios.

openQuestions.title: Show speaking state and handle voiceless environments
openQuestions.detail: The ▶ read buttons give no feedback while speechSynthesis speaks and stay silent when no voices exist; a speaking indicator (and 'no voices available' notice) would make the demo self-evident, and unique accessible names per scenario ('read scenario 1 left panel') would fix the duplicated button labels.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked read-aloud controls on the labelled simulator; zero console errors, but no visual speaking feedback exists so synthesis could not be confirmed headlessly; duplicate '▶ read left/right' names across scenarios.
